import hashlib

root = Path('products/services/welfare-tender/followon-rehearsal')

paths = [p for p in sorted(root.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()]
print('Rehearsal artifact count:', len(paths))
for path in [terms, *paths]:
    if not path.is_file():
        print('MISSING', path)
        continue
    data = path.read_bytes()
    print(path, len(data), hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest())
    if path.suffix in {'.json', '.md', '.txt'} and len(data) <= 24000:
        print(data.decode('utf-8'))
